jobs.title: Internal Tool Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Terranova**
-------------------

Terranova is a hard-tech company developing innovative systems to reshape the physical world. We combine mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, and real-world field operations to tackle complex engineering challenges.

We're looking for an **AI Tool Engineer** to help us build smarter, more efficient ways of working across our engineering, manufacturing, and field operations.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an AI Tool Engineer at Terranova, you'll develop practical AI-powered tools, software, and analytical models that improve how our team designs, builds, tests, and operates complex machinery.

This is a highly hands-on role focused on solving real engineering and operational problems. You'll work closely with mechanical, electrical, software, and field engineers to identify inefficiencies, automate repetitive workflows, and turn operational data into actionable insights.

We're looking for someone who can independently identify opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and deploy tools that make a measurable difference in how the company operates.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**AI Tools & Workflow Automation**

* Design and build internal AI-powered tools that streamline engineering, manufacturing, and operational workflows.
* Identify repetitive, manual, or cumbersome processes and develop software solutions to automate them.
* Integrate AI tools with existing engineering software, databases, documentation, and operational systems.
* Build internal applications that help engineers and operators access information, make decisions, and complete tasks more efficiently.

**Data Analysis & Process Optimization**

* Develop systems to collect, track, and analyze metrics across shop operations, equipment performance, and field activities.
* Analyze field injection data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, ground uplift, and operational efficiency.
* Build dashboards, reporting tools, and data pipelines to visualize performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Help quantify engineering and manufacturing processes to establish benchmarks, monitor performance, and reduce inefficiencies.
* Develop models to predict operational outcomes, improve process parameters, and support engineering decisions.

**Modeling & Applied AI**

* Build and deploy machine learning, statistical, and predictive models for engineering applications.
* Use LLMs, AI agents, and other emerging technologies to automate complex workflows and improve internal productivity.
* Develop tools for analyzing experimental results, identifying trends, and optimizing system performance.
* Explore new applications of AI across robotics, manufacturing, equipment monitoring, and field operations.

**Cross-Functional Engineering**

* Work directly with engineers, technicians, and operators to understand challenges and develop practical solutions.
* Take projects from problem identification through prototyping, implementation, and iteration.
* Build lightweight, maintainable tools that can be deployed quickly and improved based on real-world feedback.
* Proactively identify opportunities where software, data, or AI can improve the company's efficiency and capabilities.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building software tools, automation scripts, and data-processing pipelines.
* Experience working with LLM APIs, AI agents, machine learning frameworks, or applied AI systems.
* Ability to build end-to-end applications, from data ingestion and backend logic to simple user interfaces.
* Strong data analysis skills, including SQL, Pandas, and statistical modeling.
* Experience integrating APIs, databases, and third-party software platforms.
* Comfortable working with messy, incomplete, or unstructured real-world data.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently take loosely defined problems and turn them into working solutions.
* Interest in physical engineering systems, manufacturing, robotics, or industrial operations.
* Ability to work closely with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with industrial automation, PLCs, sensors, or equipment telemetry.
* Familiarity with mechanical engineering, fluid systems, hydraulics, or manufacturing processes.
* Experience with time-series data, predictive modeling, or optimization algorithms.
* Experience developing computer vision applications for industrial monitoring or quality control.
* Familiarity with CAD software, engineering simulations, or engineering data pipelines.
* Experience deploying internal tools using modern web frameworks and cloud services.

**Why Terranova?**
------------------

At Terranova, you'll have the opportunity to apply AI to real-world engineering problems rather than building software in isolation. Your work will directly influence how physical systems are designed, manufactured, tested, and operated.

You'll have significant ownership over projects, the freedom to experiment with new technologies, and the ability to see your solutions implemented in the shop and in the field.

We're looking for a builder who enjoys moving quickly, solving ambiguous problems, and using AI and software to make complex engineering operations more efficient.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  

In this role, you will be a part of the system software engineering group and will be responsible for software development and maintenance of on-tool, back-end software module.

  

You will work with a cross-functional team to develop software for our industry leading Laser Scanning Wafer inspection products.

  

Essential Skills:

  
  

* Hands on academic/industrial experience with programing in Java or C++
* Good understanding of Object Oriented Design, Data Structures and Algorithms
* Good problem solving and communication skills
* Ability and interest in learning new skills on the job
  

  

Preferred skills:

  
  

* Scripting languages like Python
* Domain knowledge in one of the following areas; electronic design automation (EDA), Image Processing, Image Computing, Machine Control.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Master's Level Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or relevant field and 0 years experience or Bachelor's Level Degree with 2 years experience

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  
  

**Total Rewards**

Base Pay Range: $114,800.00 - $195,200.00 Annually
Primary Location: USA-CA-Milpitas-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.
  
  
Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

  
  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  
  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at +1-408-352-2808 to request accommodation.

  
  

For additional information, view the US Know Your Rights poster on the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission website.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Network Switching
jobs.description:
At Meta, we're building and operating one of the world's most dynamic and fast-paced networks, powering our global data centers and supporting cutting-edge technologies like AI, Generative AI, Recommendation engines, and Metaverse. Our network infrastructure teams are responsible for developing, deploying, and operating this complex system, covering the entire network lifecycle from hardware development to operation. We're seeking software engineers to join our teams and help build scalable distributed systems, develop innovative solutions to our challenges, and ship them into production. As part of our network engineering teams, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge switching technology, collaborate with engineers, and contribute to the development of Meta's hyper-scale network infrastructure.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer - Network Switching Responsibilities:**

* Your contributions will affect a massive fleet of switches powering both application and AI workloads
* Design, develop, validate, and deploy control-plane and dataplane software for network switches (Meta's network switch OS), for Meta's data center front-end, AI backend, and backbone networks
* Partner with switch ASIC and system vendors on SDK integration, new feature development and platform bring-up
* Engage with network-engineering, routing infrastructure, host networking, transport teams to align on goals, lead integration efforts, and drive continuous development
* Debug complex system-level issues and lead performance tuning exercises to optimize control-plane and dataplane performance
* Partner with network operations and deployment teams for fleet-wide rollouts and incident response
* Develop and automate test suites for the CI/CD framework and various components in collaboration with test infra teams

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 7+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4+ years of experience
* 3+ years relevant experience with network devices and products (routers, switches, adapters, load balancers) and an understanding of network routing protocols in industry settings
* Proficiency in C/C++ and at least one scripting language (Python/Shell Scripting)
* Experience with developing and automating test suites
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., hardware, operations, test infrastructure) to define requirements and deliver integrated solutions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with stream processing or time-series data pipelines for high-volume network telemetry
* Experience with the design and implementation of software for high-speed network processing (e.g., Layer 2, Layer 3, MPLS, SRv6, VxLAN, ACLs, QoS, RoCEv2, Mirroring, SAI)
* Experience with intent-based network management systems
* Experience with network devices (routers, switches, load balancers) and an understanding of network routing protocols
* Experience with software-defined networking (SDN), network operating systems, or network device APIs such as OpenConfig or gNMI

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 1 year of experience with end-to-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).
* 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.
* Experience with mathematics or analytics, with experience analyzing large-scale data.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related technical field.
* 2 years of experience designing, training, and launching machine learning or deep learning models in production.
* Experience in ads ranking, conversion rate prediction, recommendation systems, or auction and bidding optimization.
* Experience with mobile advertising measurement, privacy-preserving attribution signals, or learning from sparse, delayed, or biased feedback.
* Ability to drive cross-functional machine learning and measurement projects end-to-end from problem formulation to production launch.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Join the YouTube Ads Machine Learning team to build and scale next-generation conversion prediction models and privacy-safe measurement foundations for YouTube Demand Gen and App Ads on iOS. In this role, you will manage high-impact machine learning and attribution challenges, bridging deep learning modeling, causal/counterfactual evaluation, and privacy-preserving signals to drive revenue and advertiser return on investment (ROI) across YouTube performance ad products.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, train, and launch large-scale deep learning models (such as pCVR, pInstall, pEvent, pValue, and presence models) to improve conversion prediction accuracy and advertiser return on investment (ROI) on iOS.
* Develop and integrate privacy-preserving measurement and attribution signals.
* Diagnose and resolve complex label-bias, calibration, and counterfactual evaluation challenges across online auction and bidding systems.
* Build and maintain scalable ML training, feature engineering, and model-serving pipelines.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Research, and Ads Serving/Bidding infrastructure teams to drive projects end-to-end, from large-scale data analysis and offline prototyping to online A/B experimentation and production launches.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Kiro Science
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is assembling an elite team of world-class scientists and engineers to pioneer the next generation of AI-driven development tools. Join the Amazon Kiro LLM-Training team and help create groundbreaking generative AI technologies including Kiro IDE and Amazon Q Developer that are transforming the software development landscape.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a key member of our team, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, where cutting-edge research meets real-world application:  

* Push the boundaries of reinforcement learning and post-training methodologies for large language models specialized in code intelligence
* Invent and implement state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that operate at unprecedented Amazon scale
* Deploy revolutionary products that directly impact the daily workflows of millions of developers worldwide
* Break new ground in AI and machine learning, challenging what's possible in intelligent code assistance
* Publish and present your pioneering work at premier ML and NLP conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR , ACL, EMNLP)
* Accelerate innovation by working directly with customers to rapidly transition research breakthroughs into production systems

  
About the team  
The AWS Developer Agents and Experiences (DAE) team is reimagining the builder experience through generative AI and foundation models. We're leveraging the latest advances in AI to transform how engineers work from IDE environments to web-based tools and services, empowering developers to tackle projects of any scale with unprecedented efficiency.  
  
Broadly, AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Hybrid Work  
We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near one of our U.S. Amazon offices.

------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development
* Have peer-reviewed scientific contributions in premier journals and conferences

**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As an early member of our Finance Analytics and Business Intelligence team, you will play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by establishing robust analytics engineering and business intelligence capabilities for our Finance & Accounting organization. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to ensuring accurate financial reporting, streamlining accounting processes, and supporting our financial operations as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

As a founding Data Scientist on Anthropic's Finance Forecasting team, you'll own revenue forecasting models that drive capacity planning and board reporting, build the backtesting and accuracy discipline that makes those forecasts trustworthy, and lead causal measurement work that tells us how much a given launch or event actually moved revenue — turning what is currently a best-guess conversation into a designed, repeatable readout.

We're hiring for two seats on this team, and we expect candidates to lead with depth in either production time-series forecasting or causal inference. Both shapes are first-class; tell us in your application which one feels more like you.

This is a build role on a small team. The forecast is visible inside the company, and when it's wrong, people notice. We're looking for someone who would rather have their models scored than stay vague, and who is excited to set the bar for how forecasting is done here.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own a core piece of the team's modeling work — either the production revenue forecasts themselves (scoping, development, backtesting, deployment, monitoring) or the causal measurement program for launches and events
* Build and run backtesting and accuracy tracking for your models, and use the results to improve quality cycle over cycle
* Contribute to the team's broader research direction, including event-aware forecast architectures, hierarchical reconciliation, and causal designs that hold up under launch-driven step-changes
* Translate model output and accuracy results into clear recommendations for Finance and executive leadership
* Partner with the team's Analytics Engineer on feature pipelines, model deployment, and the forecast store

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Have substantial experience in data science, forecasting, or quantitative finance, including time owning models in production rather than only in notebooks
* Are deeply fluent in Python and SQL and comfortable productionizing what you build
* Have a strong applied statistics foundation, with depth in either production time-series methods (Prophet, ETS, ARIMA, gradient-boosted approaches, neural forecasting, hierarchical reconciliation) or causal inference (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, Bayesian structural time series, event studies)
* Have built backtesting and accuracy-tracking discipline before and are comfortable having your models scored publicly
* Have presented and defended a forecast or causal estimate to executives
* Have a bias for action and do your best work in ambiguous, early-stage environments

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with exogenous-regressor or event-aware forecasting approaches
* Familiarity with hybrid or foundation-model forecasting (TimeGPT-class systems)
* Background in pricing and elasticity modeling or marketing-mix modeling

jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About Ramp Labs**
-------------------

Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 70,000+ companies use to move money. We think the defensible part of an AI product is the loop: proprietary environments, evals that track what customers care about, and models trained against both.

**About the Role**
------------------

Every model decision at Ramp Labs runs through a benchmark. Which model to route to. Whether a post-training run worked. Whether an agent is ready to post a corrective journal entry to a customer's ledger without a human in the loop.

You'll own Ramp's benchmarking effort. You'll turn real finance work (expense policy review, invoice coding, month-end close, spreadsheet Q&A) into benchmarks and RL environments, build the graders, and tell the team what is actually improving.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Build benchmarks from real workflows: turn agent traces, customer edge cases and expert labels into versioned benchmark suites for long-horizon agents that run for hours across tools and systems, plus tool use, multi-step reasoning and financial judgment
* Own the benchmarking effort: decide what we measure, run benchmark suites across models and agent versions, and report results the team makes decisions on
* Design graders: rubrics, programmatic checks and llm-as-judge, calibrated against human agreement, with a clear view of where each one breaks
* Close the loop with post-training: turn evals into reward functions and RL environments, and catch reward hacking and contamination before they ship
* Publish external benchmarks and write-ups on how models perform at real finance work

**What You Need**
-----------------

* Hands-on experience building LLM benchmarks or evals that people used to make real decisions
* Strong Python and software engineering; your eval code is reproducible and fast
* Statistical judgment: variance, confidence intervals, sample size, inter-rater agreement, and knowing when a delta is noise
* Working knowledge of post-training (SFT, RL with verifiable rewards) and how evals feed into it
* Comfort with SQL and large datasets; you'll work directly from production traces
* Taste for what is worth measuring

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Industry experience on an eval, benchmarking or post-training team
* Built RL environments or verifiers for agentic tasks
* Published benchmark or evaluation research (NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks, ICML, ACL)
* Built or contributed to eval frameworks (verifiers, lm-evaluation-harness, HELM or similar)

jobs.title: Software Engineer III — Developer Portal
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe's technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to "No Identity Left Behind" to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

ID.me is seeking a **Software Engineer III** to join the **Developer Portal** team, where we're building the self-service platform that enables organizations to rapidly integrate id.me

Identity proofing is fundamentally complex. Integrating an identity proofing flow requires many steps while meeting standards-body assurance requirements. The Developer Portal is the product that brings those pieces together for the external developer.

Today, much of that onboarding is still performed manually by in-house Solutions Consultants who have many other responsibilities. Our mission is to enable customers and their developers to register their application, configure their identity needs, test in a production-like sandbox, and launch to production all through a modern self-service experience.

This is a **backend-leaning full-stack role**. You will spend most of your time designing and building the services, APIs, and data models behind the portal — application registration, authorization, and the developer-facing APIs our customers integrate against. You'll also ship the user-facing surfaces of those services power, working in our Next.js and React frontend to take features all the way to the customer rather than handing them off at the API boundary.

You'll own features end-to-end: from API contract through database schema, deployment, and production operation. You'll take defined problems, coordinate across teams to land them safely, and grow into technical ownership of the systems you build.

Our backend services are primarily **Java (Spring Boot)** alongside legacy **Ruby** services powering identity, organizations, applications, and authorization. The frontend is a micro-frontend platform built with **Next.js**, **React**, and **TypeScript**. Previous Ruby experience is welcome but not required — we value engineers who are comfortable learning whatever technology the problem requires.

This position is based in our **Mountain View, CA** office five days per week.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Build & Ship Self-Service Developer Features**

Design and implement Developer Portal capabilities end-to-end — from API contract design through database schema, frontend integration, and deployment. Independently drive small-to-medium features, coordinating with adjacent teams where your work crosses service boundaries.

### **Own API Contracts & Data Models**

Own the data models and REST API contracts for the capabilities you build, making deliberate decisions about backwards compatibility and versioning. Our customers integrate directly against these contracts, so changes must be additive and safe by default.

### **Authentication, Authorization & Identity**

Build secure Developer Portal capabilities spanning OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, enterprise SSO, multi-tenant authorization, relationship-based access control, session management, credential management, and identity-aware application provisioning. Partner with our Identity, Organizations, Authorization, and Platform Engineering teams to evolve these capabilities without disrupting existing integrations.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

Partner with Product, Design, Architecture, and platform teams to clarify requirements, surface risks early, and keep the developer experience coherent as the platform grows.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production backend services. [Less for PhD, Master's]
* Strong experience building backend services and REST APIs using a modern web framework such as Java (Spring Boot), Ruby on Rails, Node.js, or similar.
* Deep experience with relational databases, including authoring complex SQL and performing safe schema migrations against production systems.
* Experience designing REST API contracts, including versioning and backwards compatibility, and documenting them with OpenAPI or a similar specification.
* Working proficiency with TypeScript and React — comfortable shipping customer-facing features through a modern frontend

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Who we are**

**Moveworks:** the Agentic AI Assistant platform that empowers the entire workforce.

Our platform enables employees to converse with all of their business systems through natural language to quickly find answers and automate tasks. Powered by the world's most advanced LLMs, our proprietary models, and a sophisticated Agentic AI platform, we're transforming how work gets done by allowing AI to take initiative, streamline complex workflows, and continuously learn and adapt.

Moveworks is trusted by over 5.5 million employees at more than 350 of the world’s largest companies, including 10% of the Fortune 500, to automate everyday tasks and streamline business operations. Recognized on the Forbes Cloud 100 and AI 50 lists, Moveworks was also named one of Fast Company’s 2025 Most Innovative Companies and Inc’s Best in Business, in the Best in Innovation category. Moveworks was also recognized at Microsoft’s 2025 Partner of the Year and in 2024, received the AI Breakthrough Award.

In December 2025, Moveworks was acquired by ServiceNow, marking a pivotal milestone in our journey to create a single front door to work for all business systems. By combining ServiceNow’s leading workflow automation with Moveworks’ Reasoning Engine and natural language capabilities, we deliver the AI platform for every person and every workflow. Built to go beyond basic summaries to deliver meaningful business impact. Together, our AI acts across enterprise systems to turn conversations into completed work.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the AI transformation, backed by the global scale of ServiceNow and the agility of a high-growth company. We are looking for world-class talent to help us extend agentic AI to every employee across every corner of the business. Come join us!

**ServiceNow:** it all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.

 **Job Description**

**The Role**

Moveworks' AI agents don't just generate text — they act. They plan, call tools, and change real state in enterprise systems on behalf of 5.5 million employees. That makes the central problem of our team an unusually hard measurement problem: **how do you score what an agent did — across a multi-step trajectory through a world it changed — precisely enough that the score can teach it to do better?**

That signal is what this role owns. You'll build the judgement layer of our agent evaluation platform: the rubrics, the judges, the calibration against human labels, the methodology that makes a score mean something. And the payoff is larger than a report card — a judge good enough to grade a trajectory is a judge good enough to *train against*. The same calibrated signal that explains why an agent failed becomes the reward signal that stops it failing.

This isn't a pretraining role, and it isn't a testing role. It's applied ML at a point where the methodology genuinely isn't settled: LLMs judging LLMs is an open research problem, and we're working it against agents that take real, irreversible actions in stateful, multi-tenant enterprise environments.

**What you get to do in this role:**

We're hiring across three areas. You'll anchor on one and touch the others; which one is a conversation we have with you, not a slot we drop you into.

**Eval orchestration at scale**

* The runtime that executes multi-turn agent scenarios end-to-end — stand up the environment and user simulator, drive the useragentworld loop, collect transcripts, traces, and final state, run validators and scoring, tear down
* Scheduling, retries, high-concurrency execution, and run isolation at production dataset sizes
* Versioned specs, datasets, and reports, with run-to-run comparison as a first-class operation
* Consolidating evals that run today as one-off workflows onto a single orchestration service — one source of truth, one place to schedule and retry
* Establishing a reliability floor and an SLO for the harness itself
* Getting to self-serve, so any team runs an eval without bespoke integration

**Agent observability and tracing**

* Leading the move to OpenTelemetry-native observability for the agent platform, replacing the parallel per-service logging, correlation, and redaction mechanisms in use today
* The span data model for agent trajectories — prompts, tool calls, plan updates, outcomes — so a trajectory is *queryable*, not reconstructed by hand from log files
* Trace context propagation across async boundaries and sessions that stay alive for minutes or hours
* Making full prompts and completions survive the pipeline intact, and keeping eval traffic from contaminating its own data
* Fault attribution and cross-run diffing: which component actually broke, and what changed since the last green run
* The debug surface support and harness engineers use, and the tracing contract with the team that builds the agent

**Stateful simulation**

* The simulation environment itself: stateful fakes of the enterprise systems agents call — ITSM, HR, knowledge bases, inventory — backed by a real datastore that persists changes *during* a run, so a created ticket is visible to a later read
* Per-run data injection and programmatic setup/teardown so every run is hermetic and repeatable
* LLM-driven user simulators for open-ended personas, and scripted state-machine simulators for deterministic flows
* Contract-testing mocks against real API schemas in CI, so simulation fidelity

**Company Overview**
--------------------

IDMe is the next-generation digital identity wallet that simplifies how individuals securely prove their identity online. Consumers can verify their identity with IDMe once and seamlessly login across websites without having to create a new login and verify their identity again. Over 175 million users experience streamlined login and identity verification with IDMe at 22 federal agencies, 50 state government agencies, and more than 100 healthcare organizations. Over 600 consumer brands use IDMe to verify communities and user segments to honor service and build more authentic relationships. IDMe's technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication set by the Commerce Department and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. IDMe is committed to "No Identity Left Behind" to enable all people to have a secure digital identity. To learn more, visit https://network.id.me/.

IDMe is a full-time, in-office culture. Unless a specific job description explicitly states otherwise, all roles are on-site five days per week at one of our offices in McLean, VA; Mountain View, CA; New York City, NY; or Tampa, FL. Certain roles — such as field-based sales or other remote-by-design positions — may have different work arrangements as noted in their individual postings.

At IDMe, we embrace the thoughtful use of AI tools in our daily work and there are even occasions where we leverage AI in our hiring process. However, during the interview process, we want to understand your individual skills and experiences. Therefore, we have guidelines on how AI can be appropriately used during your application and interviews which can be found here.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

ID.me is seeking a **Software Engineer II** to join the **Developer Portal** team, where we're building the self-service platform that enables organizations to rapidly integrate ID.me.

Identity proofing is fundamentally complex. Integrating an identity proofing flow requires many steps while meeting standards-body assurance requirements. The Developer Portal is the product that brings those pieces together for the external developer.

Today, much of that onboarding is still performed manually by in-house Solutions Consultants who have many other responsibilities. Our mission is to enable customers and their developers to register their application, configure their identity needs, test in a production-like sandbox, and launch to production, all through a modern self-service experience.

You'll work on the services, APIs, and data models behind the portal (application registration, authorization, and the developer-facing APIs our customers integrate against), and you'll ship the user-facing surfaces those services power in our Next.js and React frontend. You'll start with well-scoped features alongside senior engineers and grow quickly into owning features end-to-end, from API contract to production.

Our backend services are primarily **Java (Spring Boot)** alongside legacy **Ruby** services. The frontend is a micro-frontend platform built with **Next.js**, **React**, and **TypeScript**. Design, implement, test, and deploy Developer Portal capabilities across the stack: backend APIs, database changes, and the frontend experiences customers use. Start with well-defined features and bugs, then take on progressively larger and more ambiguous work as you grow.

**About Vercel:**
-----------------

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

**About the Role**
------------------

Vercel Connect helps developers give agents and AI-built apps secure access to the data, tools, and events they need—without wrestling with OAuth, credentials, and integration complexity. We’re currently building two things: 1) a platform for managing agent identity, access and permissions and 2) a set of rich connectors for the 1000s of systems (like Linear, Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.) that agents will need to talk to.

We’re solving core problems like agent identity and delegated access, tool approval and standards around making agents aware of changes on 3rd party platforms.

As a senior engineer on this team you'll not only own our APIs, token infrastructure, authorization, SDKs, and more, but work with external companies to make it easier for developers to build agents that integrate with their products. You’ll need to balance both high uptime and fast performance with flexibility to allow for seamless connection to many systems that weren’t designed with agents in mind. If you’re looking for a role that will put you at the center of how agent identity and credentials work, this is it!

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Ship provider integrations end to end — auth flows, token exchange, app registration, and the configuration UI — from generic API-key and OAuth presets through bespoke cases like Snowflake Partner Connect, Slack manager apps, and Microsoft Entra.
* Own and improve our infrastructure (uptime, performance, secure storage of credentials and keys) and developer experience for Connect
* Work with industry leaders within and outside of Vercel to propose and implement new authentication and authorization protocols for AI era
* Build and harden event forwarding — signature verification inbound, project-scoped identity outbound, delivered to the right deployment and environment.
* Make Connect the obvious way to give an agent a credential, extending the SDKs , consent-redirect flow, and framework adapters.
* Reduce the cost of the next hundred integrations, so most new providers become configuration rather than code.
* Work directly with the teams building on Connect, and turn what you learn into platform improvements.

* A **security instinct for integration code specifically** — SSRF and DNS rebinding, confused-deputy and mix-up attacks, redirect-URI validation, webhook signature verification, tenant isolation. You've either found these bugs or fixed them.
* Strong **TypeScript**, and comfort developing backend and frontend components.
* Experience integrating with **many third-party APIs**, an appetite for the reality of it — undocumented behavior, non-compliant OAuth, inconsistent errors — and the judgment to absorb that mess behind a clean abstraction.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

**About the role**
------------------

Agents are becoming first-class users of the internet. They sign in, call APIs, deploy code, and act on behalf of people and teams. That raises questions the web was never designed to answer: Who is this agent? Who does it work for? What is it allowed to do, for how long, and how do we know?

As an engineer on the [*Agent Auth and Identity*] team, you'll help answer those questions. You'll build the systems that let agents and people authenticate, delegate access, and act safely across Vercel and the services our customers connect to. This is foundational work: identity and authorization sit underneath everything we ship, and getting them right for agents will shape how modern software gets built.

The scope is intentionally broad. You might spend one quarter designing how credentials are issued and scoped for autonomous agents, and the next building the developer-facing APIs and SDKs that make secure auth feel effortless. You'll own systems end-to-end, from design through long-term operation in production.

We're looking for engineers who care deeply about security and developer experience in equal measure, enjoy working on problems without established playbooks, and want to define how trust works in an agentic world.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design, build, and operate the identity, authentication, and authorization systems that power Vercel and our Customers for both people and agents.
* Shape how agents prove who they are, act on behalf of users and teams, and receive scoped, time-bound, auditable access.
* Build secure, scalable APIs, services, and SDKs that make auth simple for developers and their agents to adopt.

* Lead projects end-to-end: identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver improvements in security, reliability, and developer experience.
* Partner closely with product, security, and platform teams across Vercel to make identity a strength of every product we ship.

jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The Database as a Service (DBaaS) engineering team builds a microservices platform that automates deployment, management, and orchestration of database clusters, messaging systems, and storage infrastructure at scale. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll architect and implement mission-critical components including our API gateway with SPIFFE/AAD authentication, Temporal-based workflow orchestration, authorization services with sub-millisecond latency, and infrastructure automation via Ansible integration.

Our platform follows a gateway-first architecture where all services communicate through a centralized gateway handling routing, authentication (AAD/SPIFFE mTLS), rate limiting, and OpenAPI aggregation. You'll work with technologies including FastAPI, MongoDB, Temporal workflows, authorization engines, and Kubernetes orchestration—all deployed via CI/CD with comprehensive observability through Prometheus and Grafana.

Tesla operates in a fast-paced environment requiring rapid iteration and architectural flexibility. You'll need to dive deep into production code, debug complex distributed systems issues, and make critical decisions that impact platform reliability. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in building scalable distributed systems, strong software engineering fundamentals, and the ability to mentor engineers while driving technical excellence through code reviews and architectural guidance.

Tesla is a fast-paced and dynamic environment that can pivot directions quickly, so the ability to quickly respond to changes in direction is critical – the answer is in the code, and you will dive in to code to find the solution(s) needed, and make changes, ensuring rapid iteration, and world-class support of our users. The ideal candidate will have a passion for building world-class software and a track record of success creating highly and scalable software systems. You will need strong software engineering skills, excellent interpersonal communication, and experience accepting and giving meaningful feedback on technical designs and pull requests.

 **What You'll Do**

* Lead architecture and design of complex microservices components within the DBaaS platform, including gateway routing, workflow orchestration, and authorization systems
* Own critical services end-to-end from design through production deployment, ensuring 99.9%+ uptime with comprehensive monitoring and alerting
* Drive technical decisions on authentication patterns (SPIFFE mTLS, AAD OAuth), caching strategies (TTL vs LRU for security-critical data), and API design (OpenAPI spec management)
* Implement and maintain strong testing discipline: pytest frameworks, unit/integration testing, mocking strategies, and >95% code coverage standards
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and architectural guidance—setting the standard for Python type safety, testing practices, and FastAPI patterns
* Collaborate with platform engineers, SREs, and product teams to deliver automated workflows for database deployment, resource management, and infrastructure provisioning
* Champion DevOps practices including Docker/Kubernetes deployment, CI/CD pipeline optimization (Jenkins), and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Tempo tracing)
* Respond rapidly to production incidents, performing root cause analysis and debugging across the stack (Python profiling, database query analysis, network tracing, Kubernetes troubleshooting)
* Evolve platform architecture to support new database engines, messaging systems, and cloud infrastructure while maintaining backward compatibility
* Lead code quality initiatives through Git workflows, code reviews, and maintaining high standards via linting (ruff, pylint) and static analysis (mypy)

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Computer Science, or equivalent, with 6+ years of working experience with deep expertise in Python (async/await, context managers, Pydantic models, type hints with mypy) and microservices architecture using FastAPI/Flask, REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications or equivalent experience
* Production experience with distributed systems technologies including MongoDB (replica sets, aggregation pipelines), PostgreSQL, and workflow orchestration frameworks (Temporal or similar)
* Expert knowledge of authentication/authorization patterns: service-to-service authentication (OAuth2, mTLS, SPIFFE), JWT validation, JWKS, group-based access control, and client certificate validation
* Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI), and infrastructure automation tools (Ansible, Terraform)
* Strong background in database systems: query optimization, schema design, and working with multiple engines (MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL) plus message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience implementing comprehensive observability: OpenTelemetry instrumentation, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, and distributed tracing in production environments
* Excellent technical communication skills for documentation, architectural proposals, and cross-team collaboration
* Experience with Go, gRPC, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Neo4j graph databases, or security frameworks is a plus

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensures our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Within AIS, the DC Robotics team is growing in maturity, so now is the time to join and drive game-changing and rapid innovation used by AWS globally. Our designs will fundamentally change the data center, providing operational and financial benefits that are critical to the success of the AWS business and its millions of customers. Our engineers solve challenging technology problems and take big bets on new concepts, enabling AWS services to continue to revolutionize the industry. This role provides the opportunity to be a technical lead driving the innovations being developed and deployed in the next generation data centers.

This role closely collaborates with mechanical engineers, ML engineers, and operations teams to ensure robot software is robust, testable, and deployable across a growing global fleet.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Enterprise
jobs.description:
**About E2B**
=============

E2B is a fast-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 8-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish.

**About the role**
==================

You'll develop the Go services behind E2B's enterprise orchestration platform, which manages deployments in customers' AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure environments.

The platform coordinates operations across remote Kubernetes clusters and gives engineers the tools to understand and manage the fleet. You'll extend the APIs and distributed workflows behind it, from design through production operation.

You'll work with SREs across Enterprise Engineering to make customer deployments reliable and easy to operate.

You'll participate in production on-call for the components you own.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Build and operate Go services for cluster installation, configuration, scaling, upgrades, recovery, and decommissioning.
* Develop distributed workflows that remain correct through partial failures, retries, and concurrent changes, and reconcile state across remote clusters.
* Build fleet tools that show cluster inventory, health, configuration drift, rollout progress, and audit history, and help engineers diagnose failures.
* Integrate Kubernetes APIs, Helm, and infrastructure packages into repeatable deployment workflows across supported cloud configurations.
* Design APIs and data models for deployment state, configuration, and access validation. Build modular, well-tested orchestration software that other engineers can confidently extend.
* Own the reliability of the services you build. Add observability and integration tests, validate releases and recovery behavior, and use incidents to address recurring failures.
* Work with FDE, Solutions, and Support on complex deployment issues and software escalations.
* Reduce manual fleet operations through automation and self-service tooling.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, ideally infrastructure control planes, deployment automation, or asynchronous services.
* Strong Go skills, including concurrency, memory management, and profiling.
* Strong distributed-systems fundamentals, including durable workflows, state machines, consistency, idempotency, and failure recovery.
* Experience designing REST or gRPC APIs, including resource models, authentication, error handling, documentation, and backward-compatible changes.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, indexes, transactions, and migrations.
* Experience testing and debugging long-running operations across unreliable networks and remote systems.
* Hands-on Kubernetes and Helm experience, including working with cluster APIs and releases. You can debug issues across Go services, cloud IAM, networks, and containers.
* You write maintainable, well-tested code and review AI-assisted changes for correctness and fit with the existing system.
* Ability to take an ambiguous backend project from design through production.

**Nice to have**
================

* Building AI agents or applications that use tools, execute code, or run in sandboxes.
* Building control planes, Kubernetes operators, or infrastructure APIs.
* Shipping BYOC, private-cloud, or self-hosted software into customer environments.
* Building multi-cloud, multi-region, or multi-tenant systems.
* Terraform modules, plans, and state; GitOps, Argo CD, or cloud-provider APIs.
* Event-driven systems, message queues, or workflow engines.
* Infrastructure, developer-tools, or AI-agent platform products.
* TypeScript or Python alongside Go.
* Open-source backend, Kubernetes, or distributed-systems contributions.

Compensation: $175K–$350K + equity

**What it’s like to work at E2B**
=================================

We’re a fast-growing startup with in-person (4 days on-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 8-figure revenue and work directly with top-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI.

We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in-office employees.

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

**About the role**

At WRITER, our mission to expand human capacity with superintelligence relies on a foundational truth: our platform must be available, performant, and reliable, 24/7. As an Infrastructure engineer, you'll be at the heart of making this a reality, impacting every enterprise customer who trusts us with their AI-powered workflows. This isn't just about keeping the lights on; it's about pushing the boundaries of what's possible, proactively identifying and solving complex systemic challenges, and laying the groundwork for our rapid growth and the evolving demands of enterprise generative AI. You'll build resilient systems, automate across the stack, and champion reliability best practices, directly enabling our ambitious product roadmap and ensuring our customers always have access to the powerful tools they need.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, or London hubs. You'll report to our director of engineering.

Encode recurring infra tasks as internal skills any teammate (human or agent) can pick up and run, so the team's throughput compounds — not just your own.
* **Debugging fluency.** Lead incident response, post-mortems, and root-cause analyses — trace failures to the underlying problem (never the symptom), apply the learning back into the architecture, and prevent the same incident from happening twice.

jobs.description:
Our technical teams rack, power, cool, cable, configure, and troubleshoot the GPU clusters that customers train and serve models on.

We are hiring an AI Infrastructure Engineer to be the technical depth of that team. This role spans the full stack of a GPU deployment: you will install and commission the hardware, configure the Linux hosts and the InfiniBand or RoCE fabric that connects them, and own the Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets that no one else can close. When a node fails repeatedly, you are the person who finds out why.

This is a hands-on role. You will still be in the aisle with a torque wrench during deployment windows. You will also write the runbook that prevents the next escalation, tune the fabric that shaved 8% off a customer’s job time, and sit in the vendor call explaining why their firmware is the root cause.

The work is hybrid. Deployment windows, hardware break-fix, and physical layer work happen on site. Configuration, diagnostics, ticket ownership, automation, and documentation can happen from wherever you work best.

What you’ll do

Escalation and root cause ownership

* Own Tier 2 and Tier 3 tickets end to end — accept escalations from Tier 1 and support teams, drive them to resolution, and close them with a documented cause rather than a reboot.

* Perform root cause analysis on server hardware failures: correlate IPMI/BMC event logs, MCE and EDAC records, kernel messages, thermal and power telemetry, and vendor diagnostics to distinguish a genuine component failure from firmware, configuration, environmental, or workload causes.

* Identify recurring failure patterns across the fleet — a DIMM slot that fails repeatedly, a firmware revision correlated with GPU falloff, a rack with marginal airflow — and drive the systemic fix.

* Lead or contribute to post-incident reviews; translate findings into monitoring, runbook, and standards changes.

* Serve as the technical escalation point for vendors: build the evidence package, defend the diagnosis, and manage RMA and field-service engagements through to closure.

* Communicate directly with customers during open incidents and maintenance windows, not only after the fact: status while the issue is live, the notice before a window, and the confirmation after it closes. Concise and factual, with no speculation about cause before it is established.

* Direct colocation remote hands in writing, to the level of cabinet, rack unit, port, and cable label, and verify the result remotely before accepting the work as done.

* Participate in a shared on-call rotation for infrastructure incidents.

**GPU systems and troubleshooting**

* Administer and troubleshoot GPU compute nodes — NVIDIA H100/H200/B200/B300 SXM and PCIe platforms, AMD Instinct, or comparable accelerators.

* Diagnose GPU-level faults using vendor tooling: nvidia-smi, DCGM and DCGM diagnostics, XID error interpretation, NVLink and NVSwitch health, ECC and row-remapping events, thermal and power throttling analysis.

* Install, update, and validate GPU drivers, CUDA toolkits, fabric manager, and container runtimes; manage version compatibility across the fleet.

* Run and interpret node validation and burn-in — NCCL tests, bandwidth and all-reduce benchmarks, GPU stress tests — before handing capacity to customers.

* Investigate performance degradation that is not an outright failure: straggler nodes, reduced collective bandwidth, PCIe link width or speed downgrades, NUMA and topology misconfiguration.

**Network administration: AI fabric and tenant connectivity**

* Configure and administer high-performance AI fabrics — InfiniBand (NDR/HDR) and RoCEv2 Ethernet — including switch configuration, firmware management, and topology validation.

* Operate InfiniBand subnet management: subnet manager configuration and failover, partitioning (P\_Keys), routing engine selection, and topology verification against the intended fat-tree or rail-optimized design.

* Troubleshoot fabric health with UFM and the OFED toolchain — ibdiagnet, ibnetdiscover, perfquery, port counters — to isolate symbol errors, link flaps, degraded optics, and bad cables to a specific port.

* Tune and validate RoCE deployments: PFC and ECN configuration, lossless queue setup, and congestion control behavior under collective traffic.

* Configure and maintain host-side networking: RDMA and OFED stacks, NIC and HCA firmware, adapter tuning, bonding, VLANs, and out-of-band management networks.

* Validate fabric performance after deployment and after change and maintain accurate port maps and topology documentation.

* Operate the tenant-facing side of the network alongside the AI fabric: VLANs and trunking, LACP port-channels across an MLAG or VLT switch pair, enterprise switch CLI, and the firewall, NAT, VPN, DHCP, and DNS configuration that customer connectivity depends on. Verify tenant segmentation and isolation against the design before capacity is handed over.

**Linux systems administration**

* Administer the Linux fleet (RHEL, Rocky, or Ubuntu) provisioning, patching, kernel and driver management, storage and filesystem configuration, user and access management.

* Operate our bare-metal provisioning system (MAAS, Foreman, Ironic, or similar) day to day: commissioning and enrollment, deploy and release cycles, image and cloud-init configuration, netplan and bonded host networking, and storage layout at deploy time, so a new node is production-ready without manual steps.

* Operate monitoring and observability for hosts, GPUs, fabric, and environment; build the alerts and dashboards that catch problems before customers do.

jobs.title: VLA/WAM Research Engineer
jobs.description:
At Flexion, we're building the intelligence layer powering the next generation of humanoid robots. Our mission is to accelerate the transition from fragile prototypes to real-world humanoid deployment. We are founded by leading scientists in robot reinforcement learning (ex-Nvidia, ex-ETH Zürich), and backed by leading international VC firms. In just months, we’ve gone from our first line of code to deploying real humanoid capabilities.

### **The role**

As our VLA/WAM Research Engineer, you'll develop the foundation models that power our humanoid robots, spanning model architecture, large-scale pre-training, adaptation, and post-training.

You will work across the model lifecycle: designing VLA and World-Action Model architectures, training foundation models on large and diverse embodied datasets, developing methods for efficient adaptation to new tasks and embodiments, and using robot experience to continuously improve model capabilities.

In particular, we are looking for researchers and engineers with deep experience in one or more of the following areas: VLA/VLM or multimodal model architecture, large-scale foundation-model pre-training, world models and predictive learning, robot learning, or post-training and continual learning. If you have strong depth in one of these areas and are excited to work across the broader problem of building general-purpose robot foundation models, you will be a strong fit for the role.

### **Key responsibilities**

* VLA/WAM Architecture: Design and develop multimodal foundation models combining vision, language, robot state, actions, and temporal context for general-purpose robotic control.
* Foundation Model Pretraining: Develop and execute large-scale pretraining across diverse robot embodiments, teleoperation, egocentric human data, and simulated experience.
* Training Recipes & Scaling: Improve data mixtures, training objectives, optimization strategies, and distributed training workflows to deliver increasingly capable foundation models on a regular cadence.
* World-Action Models: Develop predictive world and action models for representation learning, future-state prediction, planning, and robot policy improvement.
* Adaptation & Mid-training: Develop methods to efficiently adapt pretrained models to new tasks, environments, embodiments, and capabilities.
* Post-training & Reinforcement Learning: Improve models using real-world and simulated robot experience, including imitation learning, RL, reward/value-guided learning, and specialist-to-generalist distillation.
* Continual Learning: Develop methods to learn from autonomous rollouts, failures, interventions, and recoveries while retaining existing capabilities and avoiding catastrophic forgetting.
* Evaluation & Research: Design rigorous experiments, evaluate models in simulation and on real robots, and use results to guide architecture and training decisions.

  
**Requirements**  

* Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with hands-on experience developing and training modern deep-learning models.
* Research or engineering experience in one or more of the following: VLA/VLM architectures, multimodal foundation models, world models, large-scale pretraining, robot learning, or RL/post-training.
* Experience owning substantial model development or training experiments, including architecture choices, training objectives, optimization, and evaluation.
* Solid understanding of modern deep-learning architectures, representation learning, and the relationship between data, training objectives, and model performance.
* Ability to design rigorous experiments, diagnose training failures, and use empirical results to guide research decisions.
* Familiarity with large-scale datasets, model training workflows, and the challenges of generalization across tasks, environments, or embodiments.
* Ability to critically evaluate recent research and translate promising ideas into working models and experiments.
* Comfortable working across model architecture, training, and adaptation while bringing particular expertise in at least one of these areas.

**Additionally, the following are a plus but not required:**

* Experience training VLA, VLM, diffusion, flow-matching, video/world models, or other multimodal generative architectures.
* Experience with distributed training, multi-node GPU systems, large-scale data mixtures, and foundation-model training optimization.
* Experience with reinforcement learning, offline RL, reward/value learning, specialist distillation, or continual learning.
* Experience with predictive world models, video generation, latent dynamics, or self-supervised representation learning.
* Experience with multi-embodiment robot learning, action representations, or adapting policies across different robot platforms.
* Experience working with teleoperation, egocentric video, simulation, autonomous rollouts, or other large-scale embodied datasets.
* Experience evaluating learned policies on real robots, particularly humanoids or dexterous manipulation systems.

* Joining Europe's leading robotics team & exposure to never-done-before research
